a little throwback to one of the first meals i ate with my friends back in philly ! we fought for our lives to eat this meal actually - it was freezing, snowing, and windy. just terrible. the restaurant far surpassed my expectations and had great flavours ! pleasantly surprised by how fresh the sashimi was especially since philadelphia is definitely not known for its seafood. had a great time celebrating my friends birthday here though and the service was lovely ! 🫶🏻🫶🏻 a great pick for some japanese food in philly 😋

Hibachi & Japanese Restaurant

A new restaurant just opened in Center City. @uni.philly offers a fantastic selection of sushi, hibachi, and appetizers. This is another restaurant that we loved and left with no leftovers 🤣

You have to order the mixed soft-shell crab tempura 🦀 if hibachi is on the menu, I’m ordering it. The hibachi special was so good and great to split between 3 people. We ordered the uni platter, which comes with a variety of sushi and salmon lava bombs 🍣 

Go check them out!

We recently checked out @uni.philly - Uni Japanese Cuisine! Everything was so delicious! 😋💖🍣

We got these delicious delights:
Salmon Lava Bombs 🍣🔥
Gyoza 🥟 
Tuna 🍣 Truffle Roll 
Sexy Lady Roll 

I absolutely loved the Salmon 🍣 Lava Bombs - so unique and scrumptious! I’ve never had anything like it before and will definitely be back for more! 😋💖

I also loved the Sexy Lady Roll - the flavors in it were incredible! 😋💖

They have so many unique special rolls on their menu - can’t wait to go back and try more! 

It is also a BYOB! 🥂❤️

This restaurant recently opened and is located on 1900 Pine Street in Philadelphia PA. If you’re in Philly - be sure to check it out! 😋🍣❤️

Thanks @uni.philly for the delicious dinner! See you again soon! 💖😋🍣
